shell.title: Privacy Policy
shell.description: How personal information is handled when you contact or book with Amanda Hecimovic Counselling.

sections.title: Information you share
paragraphs: When you email the practice or book through Jane App, you may share contact details and information about why you are reaching out. That information is used only to respond to your inquiry, coordinate appointments, and provide the services you request.

sections.title: How information is used
paragraphs: Practice communications are used to reply to questions, schedule care, and support ongoing counselling when you become a client. Information is not sold or shared for marketing.

sections.title: Health information
paragraphs: Please avoid sending detailed personal health information by general email. Clinical intake, records, and ongoing care are handled through secure professional systems appropriate for counselling practice.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Online booking is provided through Jane App, which processes scheduling and related details under its own privacy practices. Email providers and hosting services may process messages and site traffic as needed to operate the website.
